arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
import importlib.util, importlib.machinery, json, random
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader('sub', importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader('sub', '/app/submit/solver.py'))
sub = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(sub)
rng = random.Random(2)
fib = []
for i in range(2048):
    # top 11 bits distinct and nonzero-in-every-group below them
    top = (i | 0x400) & 0x7ff          # 11 bits, bit10 set -> group0 nonzero
    mid = 0x0111                        # bits 96..111 -> group1 nonzero (5 bits used)
    low = (rng.getrandbits(96) | 0x0101010101010101)  # groups 2..7 nonzero
    a = (top << 117) | (mid << 101) | low
    fib.append((a, 128, i % 65535))
for (a, L, h) in fib:
    assert all((a >> (112 - 16*g)) & 0xFFFF for g in range(8)), 'zero group'
    assert len(sub.fmt_addr(a).split('::')) == 1 or True
cuts = list(range(0, 128, 8)) + [128]
caps = [1000000000]*16
stages, used, raw = sub.build_layout(fib, cuts)
num, den = sub.peak_fraction(used, caps)
img = {'status':'ok','capacities':caps,'max_stride':8,'cuts':cuts,'stages':stages,
       'used_bits':used,'peak':{'num':num,'den':den}}
addrs = []
while len(addrs) < 20000:
    v = rng.getrandbits(128)
    if all((v >> (112-16*g)) & 0xFFFF for g in range(8)):
        addrs.append(sub.fmt_addr(v))
req = json.dumps({'op':'lookup','image':img,'addresses':addrs})
cnt = req.count(',') + req.count(':') + req.count('[') + req.count('{')
print('no-compression maximal request: %.2f MB, counted chars: %d (margin %.2fx)'
      % (len(req)/1e6, cnt, 3000000/cnt))
sub.validate_image(img)
print('validates OK; sample prefix:', stages[2]['nodes'][0]['prefix'])
EOF
